name: cron-next
title: Next run time of a cron expression
prompt:
Implement `next_run(expression, after)` in `cron.py`: return the first `datetime` STRICTLY after
`after` (seconds and microseconds = 0, same tzinfo) that matches a 5-field cron expression
`minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week`.
- ranges: minute 0-59, hour 0-23, day-of-month 1-31, month 1-12, day-of-week 0-7 (0 and 7 = Sunday)
- each field supports `*`, numbers, ranges `a-b`, lists `a,b,c`, and steps `*/n`, `a-b/n`, `a/n`
  (`a/n` means from a to the end of the range every n)
- Vixie-cron rule: if BOTH day-of-month and day-of-week are restricted (neither starts with `*`),
  a day matches when EITHER matches; otherwise both must match
- raise `ValueError` for invalid expressions (wrong field count, out-of-range values, step 0,
  reversed ranges like `5-1`, garbage) and when no time matches within 8 years (e.g. `0 0 30 2 *`)
